questions.stem: A cuboid has dimensions 8 cm, 6 cm, and 5 cm (height). Find the angle that the space diagonal makes with the base of the cuboid (the 8 cm by 6 cm face). Give your answer to 1 decimal place.
questions.explanation: Base diagonal = sqrt(8^2 + 6^2) = sqrt(64 + 36) = sqrt(100) = 10 cm. The space diagonal rises 5 cm (height) over a horizontal base diagonal of 10 cm. tan(theta) = 5/10 = 0.5. theta = tan^(-1)(0.5) = 26.6 degrees (1 d.p.).

questions.stem: A square-based pyramid has a base of side 12 cm and a vertical height of 8 cm. Find the slant height from the apex to the midpoint of a base edge.
questions.explanation: The distance from the centre of the base to the midpoint of a base edge is half the base side = 6 cm. Slant height = sqrt(6^2 + 8^2) = sqrt(36 + 64) = sqrt(100) = 10 cm.

questions.stem: A cuboid ABCDEFGH has AB = 4 cm, BC = 3 cm, and CG = 12 cm (height). Find the length AG.
questions.explanation: AG is the space diagonal. AG = sqrt(4^2 + 3^2 + 12^2) = sqrt(16 + 9 + 144) = sqrt(169) = 13 cm.

questions.stem: In a cuboid with dimensions 5 cm by 5 cm by 10 cm, find the angle between the space diagonal and the longest edge (10 cm side). Give your answer to 1 decimal place.
questions.explanation: Space diagonal = sqrt(25 + 25 + 100) = sqrt(150). The angle between the space diagonal and the 10 cm edge: cos(theta) = 10/sqrt(150) = 10/12.247 = 0.8165. theta = cos^(-1)(0.8165) = 35.3 degrees (1 d.p.).

questions.stem: A cone has radius 5 cm and vertical height 12 cm. What angle does the slant surface make with the base? Give your answer to 1 decimal place.
questions.explanation: The slant makes an angle with the base where tan(theta) = height/radius = 12/5 = 2.4. theta = tan^(-1)(2.4) = 67.4 degrees (1 d.p.).
